title: 雅思阅读 #1 · 垂直农业（剑桥真题风 TFNG）
goal: 贴近剑桥真题的阅读判断题训练：定位 + 同义替换 + 区分 FALSE（矛盾）与 NOT GIVEN（未提及）。

passages.title: Vertical farming
passages.body: Vertical farming is a method of growing crops in stacked layers inside buildings. Unlike traditional farming, it uses artificial lighting and controlled environments, which allows crops to be produced all year round. In Singapore, vertical farms now supply about 5% of the city's vegetables. Supporters argue that the method uses far less water than conventional agriculture. However, critics point out that the high cost of electricity makes vertical farming much more expensive than traditional methods. Several companies are currently working on ways to reduce these costs, and researchers believe the industry will continue to grow in the coming decades.

questions.prompt: Vertical farming makes it possible to grow crops throughout the year.
questions.explanation: 定位到第 2 句：controlled environments...allows crops to be produced all year round。题干「throughout the year」= 原文「all year round」同义替换 → TRUE。

questions.prompt: Vertical farms supply most of the vegetables consumed in Singapore.
questions.explanation: 定位到第 3 句：supply about 5% of the city's vegetables。题干说「most（大部分）」，原文是 5%——数字直接矛盾 → FALSE，不是 NOT GIVEN（原文明确给出了数字）。

questions.prompt: The Singaporean government provides financial support to vertical farms.
questions.explanation: 原文通篇没有提到政府（government）或资助（financial support）——这是原文之外的新信息，既不矛盾也没证实 → NOT GIVEN。注意：不要因为「合理」就选 TRUE。

questions.prompt: Researchers predict that the vertical farming industry will keep expanding in the future.
questions.explanation: 定位到最后一句：researchers believe the industry will continue to grow in the coming decades。「keep expanding in the future」=「continue to grow in the coming decades」同义替换 → TRUE。
